reviews.title: Very good protection with adequate stiffness
reviews.body: I had made a stiffener for my laptop backpack out of foamboard and a large sheet of felt to protect my 16" OLED laptop during travel. Although this setup didn't provide any extra protection for the edges nor the back of the computer. It took some searching to find a case made to fit the ASUS VivoBook S 16 OLED, but this Smatree MS89 fits perfectly. It's not quite as stiff as the foam board, but it seems to provide adequate stiffness plus plenty of extra protection for travel in the backpack. It's a bit too big to fit in the dedicated laptop envelope within the laptop compartment in the backpack, but it fits easily in the compartment itself. I recommend this sleeve case.
